y-m-04-02.title: 4 pa plate imwe neimwe ye 3, 3 pa plate imwe neimwe ye 4
y-m-04-02.topic: Zvinoreva kuwanza (nhamba iri mubhandi rimwe nehuwandu hwemabhandi)
y-m-04-02.goal: Tarisa neuwandu hwema dots nei 3×4 ne 4×3 zvine mutengo mumwechete, uye usiyanise kuti kunyange mitengo yakafanana, 'nyaya' (huwandu hwemabhandi nenhamba iri mubhandi rimwe) haina kufanana.
y-m-04-02.material: Verenga kuwanza 3×4 kuti zvinoreva 'mabhandi 4 e 3', uye 4×3 kuti zvinoreva 'mabhandi 3 e 4'. (3×4 inoverengwa "katatu ka4" uye 4×3 inoverengwa "ka4 ka3".) Plate imwe neimwe ine maapuro akaenzana, uye hapana maapuro asara kana akashaikwa. Doyun akati, 'Maplate 4 e 3 nemaplate 3 e 4 akasungwa zvakasiyana, saka huwandu hwemaapuro huchasiyanawo.'
y-m-04-02.thinking.1: Kugadzirisa kutonga kwako nekuvimba kwako neruzivo rutsva
y-m-04-02.s.s1.prompt: Funga mashoko aDoyun uchitarisa ruzivo danho nedanho.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kuti utarise mashoko aDoyun, verenga maapuro iwe pachako kana kuadhonza semadots.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kuti mitsetse inochinja sei kana uchitarisa madots amwechete kubva kune imwe direction.

y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Hapana chakaverengwa, saka zvakaoma kutaura kuti akarurama kana kwete. Saka ngatiaadhonzei semadots.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Zvakarurama. Kana nzira yekusunga yakasiyana, huwandu hwose hwakasiyanawo
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Pfungwa iyi yakaitora pakarepo kuti kana nzira yekusunga yakasiyana, huwandu hwose hwakasiyanawo.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Hazvizikanwi zvino. Unofanira kuverenga kana kudhonza kuti utarise
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Pfungwa iyi yakamira kutonga nekuti hapana humbowo.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Zvisina kururama. Kunyange mabhandi akasiyana, huwandu hwose hunogara hwakafanana
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Mhedziso ingava yakarurama, asi pfungwa iyi yakaitaura isina kutarisa.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Madots 12 akaiswa mumitsetse mitatu ine 4 mupamhi. Pepa rakatendeudzirwa padivi pasina kuwedzera kana kubvisa dot rimwe chete, rakava mitsetse mina ine 3 mupamhi.

y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Zvose pfungwa yekutarisa nemuenzaniso mumwe wobva waedza zvakawanda, nepfungwa yekuti chikonzero che 'madots anoramba akadaro kana atendeudzwa' chinoshandawo kune dzimwe nhamba, zvakakodzera.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Pfungwa iyi yakanzwa kuti huwandu hwakachinja kunyange madots akatendeudzwa. Tarisa kana wakamboisa kana kubvisa dot.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Mumamiriro aya akafanana. Ndinoda kutarisa zvakawanda kana ichiita saizvozvo kune dzimwe nhamba zvakare
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Pfungwa iyi inosimbisa kufanana mumuenzaniso mumwe uye inoda kutarisa mamwe mamiriro zvakaparadzana.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Unogona kungotendeudza madots, saka unogona kutaura kuti huwandu hwakafanana mukuwanza kwedzimwe nhamba zvakare
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Pfungwa iyi yakaona kuti chikonzero che 'huwandu hwemadots hahuchinji kana hwatendeudzwa' chinoshandawo kune dzimwe nhamba.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Maapuro mumamiriro maviri akafanana, 12. Doyun akati zvakare, 'Huwandu hwemaapuro hwakafanana, saka nyaya mbiri dzakafanana zvachose.'
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Huwandu hwemaapuro hwakafanana, 12, asi maplate 3 nemaplate 4, uye 4 paplate imwe ne 3 paplate imwe, zvakasiyana. Kunyange mitengo yakafanana, nyaya hadzina kufanana.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Zvose huwandu hwemaapuro nehuwandu hwemaplate zvakafanana zvachose
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Pfungwa iyi yakafunga zvakawanda kuti nekuti huwandu hwemaapuro hwakafanana, zvose zvakafanana. Enzanisa huwandu hwekutanga hwemaplate.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Zvose huwandu hwemaapuro nehuwandu hwemaplate zvakasiyana
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Pfungwa iyi yakadzokera kune zvakatarisirwa pakutanga. Takatarisa nedot array kana huwandu hwemaapuro hwakafanana.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Huwandu hwemaapuro hwakafanana uye huwandu hwemaplate hwakasiyana
y-m-04-02.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga, waigona kumira kutonga nekuti wakanga usati wasimbisa. Kana wakatendeudza madots, wakawana humbowo hwekuti 'huwandu hwakafanana,' uye kana wakadzokera kunyaya yemaplate, kuti unogona kutaura 'zvakafanana' kusvika kupi (huwandu chete hwakafanana) kwakachinja. Taura kuti ruzivo rupi rwakachinja kutonga kupi.

y-m-04-02.s.s2.explain: Mutsetse 3 hauna kururama. Kunyange mitengo yakafanana, huwandu hwemaplate nehuwandu hwemaapuro paplate imwe zvakasiyana, saka nyaya hadzina kufanana. Mitsetse 1, 2, ne 4 yakarurama.
y-m-04-02.s.s3.prompt: Udza Doyun mumitsara miviri kana mumwe. Nyora uchisanganisira zvose zvakafanana nezvakasiyana mumamiriro maviri.

y-m-04-04.title: Nhamba dziri mumabhokisi eruvara dzinoitei pateni?
y-m-04-04.goal: Rongedza mapateni anogona kutaurwa nenzira dzakawanda kubva kumabhokisi eruvara akafanana, dzidza kuti pateni inoenderana nechimiro chetebhura (huwandu hwemabhokisi mumutsara), uye utsvage pateni zvakare mutebhura itsva.
y-m-04-04.material:
Iyi itebhura yenhamba ine nhamba 5 mumutsara mumwe nemumwe, yakanyorwa kubva ku1 kusvika ku25. Bhokisi rechitatu mumutsara mumwe nemumwe rakaitwa ruvara. Nhamba dzakaitwa ruvara i3, 8, 13, 18, ne23.
Mutsara 1: 1 2 3 4 5
Mutsara 2: 6 7 8 9 10
Mutsara 3: 11 12 13 14 15
Mutsara 4: 16 17 18 19 20
Mutsara 5: 21 22 23 24 25
y-m-04-04.thinking.0: Kurongedza kuti ndeapi mutsananguro dzakawanda dzepateni akarurama

y-m-04-04.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvirevo zvose zvakarurama pamusoro penhamba dzakaitwa ruvara.

y-m-04-04.s.s1.r.a: Pfungwa iyi yakataurwa nekutarisa chikamu chete pasina kuongorora 3, 8, 13... imwe nenguva. 8 ne18 dzi even.

y-m-04-04.s.s1.r.b: Pfungwa iyi yakawana pateni umo ones digit inodzokororwa.
y-m-04-04.s.s1.o.c: Nhamba dzakaitwa ruvara dzinotanga ku3 uye dzinokura ne5
y-m-04-04.s.s1.r.c: Pfungwa iyi yakatarisa musiyano pakati penhamba dzakaitwa ruvara dziri padhuze.

y-m-04-04.s.s1.r.d: Pfungwa iyi yakaunganidza ones digits dzenhamba ndokuzvitarisa.
y-m-04-04.s.s1.explain: 3, 8, 13, 18, ne23 dzinokura ne5, uye ones digit inochinjana pakati pe3 ne8. 8 ne18 dzi even, saka 'dzose odd' haina kururama. Mutsara mumwe chete wenhamba unogona kutsanangurwa nenzira dzakawanda.
y-m-04-04.s.s2.prompt: Takagadzira tebhura itsva nekunyora nhamba dzakafanana ne6 mumutsara mumwe nemumwe. Panguva ino futi bhokisi rechitatu remutsara mumwe nemumwe rakaitwa ruvara, uye nhamba dzakaitwa ruvara dzakava 3, 9, 15, ne21. Hyeonseo akati, 'Pateni yekukura ne5 chivakwa chenhamba pachadzo, saka yakarurama mutebhura ipi zvayo.' Unofunga chii?

y-m-04-04.s.s2.hint.1: Fananidza kukosha uku nehuwandu hwemabhokisi mumutsara mumwe.
